market_analysis.market_type_reason: The market is B2B because the primary buyers are finance departments, enterprise organizations, and accounting teams looking to streamline business payment workflows.
market_analysis.market_definition: The Accounts Payable Automation market consists of software solutions that automate the processing, verification, approval, and execution of supplier invoices and business-to-business payments.
market_analysis.core_scope: A company must develop and provision software platforms that automatically ingest invoices, match them against purchase orders, manage approval workflows, and facilitate electronic payments to suppliers.
adjacent_segments: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) core accounting modules
Manual book-keeping and outsourced accounting services

market_participants.definition: SaaS and cloud software companies that design, host, and sell accounts payable automation platforms.
market_participants.why_relevant: They are the vendors providing the technical capabilities, AI extraction tools, and workflow engines that corporate buyers purchase.

market_participants.definition: IT consulting and implementation firms that configure and connect third-party AP automation software with complex legacy ERP networks.
market_participants.why_relevant: Large enterprise buyers often contract these firms to ensure smooth data flows between their new AP software and existing accounting records.

market_analysis.primary_reason: Solution Provider is the chosen role because the competitive core of this market consists of software-as-a-service companies selling digital automation platforms, rather than organizations performing physical production or manual service workflows.
